title: Pink slip one engineer
text:
Pink slip one engineer. It's a shame. My wife really liked this blanket and it worked well for a couple years. Unfortunately whoever engineered the electrical cord plug-in did a lousy job of designing for much cord twisting over time. The wire broke right where it enters the plug and this blanket was treated quite kindly.

Update: 10-10-2014 The manufacturer replaced the blanket. The new one works just as well as the original we bought. This edit is also my record of when it was replaced and watching the warranty period from this date now. I noticed the new transformer is quite a bit smaller than the original, yet has the exact same input/output specs. Part numbers on both the transformer and controller are different than the original we bought. The Molex (MLX) connector they use where it plugs into the blanket itself is exactly the same setup. Since this was the weak link on our first blanket I'm somewhat skeptical as to how long this connection point will last on this new one. I hope not, but am afraid quite a few of the 5 star reviews may sour over time as owners update failure rates.

features: MATERIALS: Made from luxurious ultra-soft micro-fleece with built in micro-thin wires for more even heat distribution without the bulkiness.

FEATURES: Patented Safe & Warm non-hazardous low voltage technology is safe in the presence of moisture, will not harm pets, and emits no EMFs. Our patented low voltage technology is the only electric mattress pad technology that is certified as non-hazardous. Single control automatically shuts off after 10 hours for convenience. Giant backlit display with auto dimming feature for night time adjustments with out having to turn on the lights
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash in warm water and tumble dry on low setting
description: Soft Heat Luxury Micro-Fleece Electric Heated Warming Blanket is probably one of the most plush warming blankets you'll ever have the luxury of snuggling up in. That's just one of the wonderful features of this blanket because within the incredibly soft micro-fleece fabric is the pantented Safe & Warm low-voltage technology. This low-voltage blanket includes a small power supply box that changes 120 volt AC home current into non-hazardous low voltage DC current (very similar to a battery) to provide warmth, protection and safety even if the blanket becomes wet. Unlike other warming blankets with their bulky wires, the heating wires in the Soft Heat blankets are so small, they are virtually unnoticeable and also give more of an even heat meaning-no hot or cold spots. The full size blanket comes standard with one easy to read, easy to turn, non-slip computerized controller to adjust the temperature of the blanket. With an automatic pre-heat and hold feature you simply turn it on and the blanket will warm up on HI until it reaches the temperature that you pre set your dial on and then adjusts itself to hold it there. For your safety and convienience it has an automatic shut off feature that will shut the blanket off after 10 hours just in case you forget. It also comes standard with built in over-temperature protection for that extra bit of safety and piece of mind. Easy care feature means that it's machine washable and dryable and will not stretch, pill or shrink giving you many years of warm luxurious use.This warming product has been designed to provide you a gentle relaxing heat. It will NOT feel warm to the touch of your hand, even on the highest (HI) setting.You must actually use it to experience the cozy warmth that it will generate.If the control lamp is lit, it is working.
